Reading this report

Empty passwords: 1. Masks preserve byte order: ?u uppercase, ?l lowercase, ?d digit, ?s printable ASCII symbol/space, ?b any byte.

Non-ASCII and control bytes use ?b. Invalid text and controls are displayed as $HEX[]. CSV prefixes formula-like text with an apostrophe; Summary JSON retains exact display values. Empty passwords have no runnable mask.

All analysis runs locally. This report makes no network requests.
